findings.title: 48-digit recovery passwords are written to audit/trace when used as a search value
findings.evidence: Components/Pages/BitLockerRecovery.razor:268 - the page treats the recovery-screen identifier field as the search target; Components/Pages/BitLockerRecovery.razor:293 - the raw target is passed to Audit.LogLookupAction; Services/AuditService.cs:206 - LogLookupAction writes that target into the audit event.
findings.predicted_failure: If an operator searches using a pasted 48-digit BitLocker recovery password, the full disk-decryption key is persisted as the audit target and can also become the implicit operation target, violating the stated rule that recovery keys never reach audit records or traces.
findings.better_approach: When the parsed identifier is a RecoveryPassword, audit only a non-secret descriptor such as a recovery-password search marker, never the raw password. Keep full key IDs auditable if desired because they are identifiers, not the recovery password.

findings.title: Empty truncated live searches are shown as complete no-key results
findings.evidence: Services/BitLockerLiveDirectorySearch.cs:58 - live computer searches cap matching computer candidates at limit + 1 before reading recovery children; Services/BitLockerLiveDirectorySearch.cs:118 - the result is marked truncated when more computer candidates existed; Components/Pages/BitLockerRecovery.razor:97 - the empty-results branch ignores truncated and reports no keys found, while the truncation notice is only rendered in the non-empty branch at line 116.
findings.predicted_failure: A broad live AD search can examine only the first capped set of matching computers, find no keys there, and still have matching computers with keys beyond the cap. The operator sees 'No recovery keys found. Live Active Directory and the archive were searched successfully' instead of being told the search was incomplete and must be narrowed.
findings.better_approach: Surface truncation even when results.Count is zero, and avoid wording that says the search was complete. Prefer continuing or paging the live search until the key result limit is reached, or explicitly require a narrower query when the computer candidate set is capped.
